name: Heber
overview: The name Heber appears in Scripture referring to multiple individuals, notably a head of families within the tribes of Asher and Gad, as well as a Benjamite descendant of Beriah. One prominent Heber is identified as a Kenite who separated from his kin and settled near Kedesh, where his household maintained peace with King Jabin of Hazor. His wife Jael is celebrated for her courageous act in delivering Israel from Sisera, highlighting the significant role of Heber's family in God's providential deliverance of His people.
